notes: Full macOS test build based on 143, including its trackpad and keyboard fixes. Audio playback now wakes a virtual CPU when a guest buffer finishes or the audio ring has room to refill. In the M4 scrolling test this removed about 88% of audio wake requests. Scrolling results varied: the audio change used 15% less modeled process power after resume in separate builds (median of four pairs), while a same-boot comparison used 2% more and submitted fewer frames. Build 143 is available for comparison. M5 iPad battery runtime is unmeasured.
